description: Boundary-focused benchmark for implicit invocation. Positive and negative cases are interleaved; negatives deliberately contain high-risk vocabulary without requesting high-risk engineering execution.

cases.prompt: 流量已经切到新版本但错误率在上升，直接找出原因、修好并确保现有会话不受影响。
只解释蓝绿部署切流时常见的生产风险，不要查看或修改任何仓库，也不要执行发布。
登录接口偶尔接受已经撤销的令牌，请在不强制所有用户下线的前提下把问题修掉。
为安全培训概括令牌撤销为什么困难，只需要三段说明文字。
新字段已经有部分实例在写了，补齐剩余数据并让旧版本继续正常读写。
审阅这份数据库迁移方案的文字描述并列出疑问，不要运行 SQL 或改代码。
把订单状态中的 cancelled 拆成两个状态，调用方不能同时升级。请完成兼容改造。
解释为什么共享 API 契约变更需要兼容窗口，仅回答概念，不制定或执行改造。
这个供应商 SDK 今天刚改了签名，现有示例互相矛盾。接入它并证明失败重试不会重复提交。
把下面这段第三方 SDK 更新公告翻译成中文，保留 API 名称即可。
两个 worker 偶尔同时领取同一条任务，修复后还要覆盖进程在写入中途退出的情况。
用一个不涉及真实代码的例子说明竞态条件，最多十行伪代码。
用户注销后仍能在离线报表里查到标识符，请修正整条处理链并验证历史数据清理。
润色隐私政策里关于删除请求的一段话，不需要核验系统实现。
前两次都把超时当成网络问题处理了但故障仍在，换一个观察层级继续定位并修复。
总结这三次失败尝试中已经排除的假设，只做记录，不继续调试。
一个看似局部的序列化改动让三个服务的缓存键不一致，请定位影响范围并完成修复。
把“序列化改动可能影响多个服务”改写成更清楚的代码审查提醒。
夜间任务会留下半成品文件，补上可恢复机制，并验证再次执行不会污染已完成结果。
列出批处理任务通常需要哪些恢复指标，作为会议讨论清单，不接触系统。
The release is live in one region and corrupting cache entries. Diagnose and repair it without invalidating healthy regions.
Summarize the supplied production incident timeline for a postmortem draft; do not investigate or change the system.
A service account can read another tenant's exports. Fix the boundary while preserving legitimate automation.
Explain tenant isolation to a nontechnical audience without reviewing implementation details.
Some rows use the old timezone convention and some use the new one. Normalize them without double-adjusting either group.
Turn this proposed migration checklist into a Markdown table; do not assess whether the steps are safe.
One mobile client omits a field the server now requires. Make the rollout tolerate both payload shapes and add regression coverage.
Give me five questions to ask before changing a public API. This is brainstorming only.
Upgrade the parser to address its advisory, but keep the undocumented input form our import pipeline currently accepts.
Format the dependency advisory text as a short changelog entry without recommending or performing an upgrade.
Requests can be retried after the response is lost. Make account creation idempotent across concurrent retries and test the race.
Compare mutexes and idempotency keys in a small conceptual table; no repository work is requested.
Debug logs are useful but currently include reset links. Keep enough diagnostics while removing recoverable credentials everywhere.
Proofread this sample redaction policy. Treat all examples as fictional and do not inspect logs.
The test passes alone but fails after the integration suite. Find the state leak, fix it, and distinguish any unrelated failures.
Explain what test-order dependence means and list possible causes, with no code changes.
Renaming this configuration key touches the CLI, service, deployment chart, and docs. Complete the coordinated change with compatibility checks.
Correct the capitalization of one configuration key in a documentation heading only.
The cleanup command can be interrupted after deleting metadata but before deleting blobs. Make reruns safe and provide recovery evidence.
Draft a read-only checklist for reviewing a cleanup command. Do not execute commands or propose code edits.
